rows.note: Use this when the irritation is felt as pent-up anger or resentment rather than mild annoyance.

example.english: Being wrongly blamed for so long has left me full of irritation.
example.traditional: 俾人屈咗咁耐，我真係一肚氣。
example.jyutping: bei2 jan4 wat1 zo2 gam3 noi6 ngo5 zan1 hai6 jat1 tou5 hei3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for a nuisance, annoyance, or troublesome act or thing.

example.english: Those constant sales calls are a real irritation.
example.traditional: 成日打嚟推銷嘅電話真係好麻煩。
example.jyutping: seng4 jat6 daa2 lai4 teoi1 siu1 ge3 din6 waa6 zan1 hai6 hou2 maa4 faan4

rows.note: Use this in a medical context for inflammation or painful irritation of the skin.

example.english: The doctor says this red, swollen patch is contact irritation.
example.traditional: 醫生話呢片紅腫係接觸性皮膚炎。
example.jyutping: ji1 saang1 waa6 ne1 pin3 hung4 zung2 hai6 zip3 zuk1 sing3 pei4 fu1 jim4
